args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on Feb 16.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" (per Moss's coverage check, May 18).
- Supervisors searching for the old label end up searching twice. The report-label change is on the handoff list.
- Open item: we can't yet confirm whether the saved report label has been updated.
- Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti (drafted by assistant for Bettina Kroll)
